name: TourGuideAssignmentPlanner
tagline: Staff every tour with the right guide – language, licence, availability, fees and ratings in one app.
description: A complete guide-desk app for tour operators and DMCs: see unstaffed and unconfirmed departures, auto-assign the best free guide who speaks the language and holds the site licence, avoid double bookings and over-long days, track offers through confirmation, fees and post-tour ratings – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Best-match guide ranking with reasons and blockers
Double booking, turnaround, daily hours and days-per-week checks
Offer → accept → confirm workflow with rules, reasons and undo
Guide roster as one low-code text property
Guide run sheet CSV and export
Post-tour star ratings and average feedback
Demo mode, read-only, disabled and phone layouts
react: 16.14.0 (bundled, no platform library, no Fluent UI)
